apps.name: Frame Link
apps.subtitle: A second iPhone as your live viewfinder.
apps.localizedDescription:
Use a nearby iPhone to check the composition while taking photos on the camera phone. Full-resolution photos stay in Photos on the camera phone; captured photos are not transferred to the viewing phone.

Both iPhones need iOS 26 or later, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth enabled, and Frame Link open in the foreground. Frame Link itself needs no account or internet connection.

The Recent photos screen keeps cached previews. Deleting a photo there also deletes its linked original from Photos, which can sync through iCloud Photos.
